searched: Searched on 2026-10-27: arXiv (abstract pages and PDFs, version 1) and the arXiv API for ERNIE titles (ERNIE 1904.09223, ERNIE 2.0 1907.12412, ERNIE 3.0 2107.02137, ERNIE 3.0 Titan 2112.12731, ERNIE 5.0 Technical Report 2602.04705; the API also lists an ERNIE-Image Technical Report, not used); SEC EDGAR filing index for Baidu (CIK 1329099) and the Form 20-F filed 15 March 2024 and 17 March 2026, retrieved through the r.jina.ai relay; ir.baidu.com (press-release list reachable only through the relay, and its date filter did not apply; a guessed ERNIE Bot release URL returned 404); Baidu's PR Newswire releases of 16 March 2023 (ERNIE Bot) and 16 March 2025 (ERNIE 4.5 and ERNIE X1), found through web search and retrieved directly; the PaddlePaddle/ERNIE Git repository (blob-less clone, README.md and LICENSE pinned at commit a95ef9dc of 30 June 2025); Hugging Face baidu/ERNIE-4.5-300B-A47B-PT (commit list, README.md and LICENSE at commit 049f3d9b of 29 June 2025) and the baidu model listing. Retrieval failures: the ERNIE 4.5 technical report PDF at yiyan.baidu.com timed out directly (HTTP/2 errors) and the relay returned only the ERNIE assistant's application shell, so the report is not cited; no arXiv version of the ERNIE 4.5 report was found by the arXiv API. No Chinese-language Baidu original for the ERNIE Bot (文心一言) launch was located on home.baidu.com or ir.baidu.com by search; the English releases are cited instead. The Internet Archive was not consulted (refused from this environment).

claims.subject: baidu
claims.statement: Baidu announced ERNIE Bot on 16 March 2023, stating that it would be accessible to invited users from that day and that its API would be available on application to enterprise clients through Baidu AI Cloud.

time.note: Dateline and distribution date of the press release. Baidu's 20-F filed on 15 March 2024 places the ERNIE Bot launch in the quarter from January to March 2023; the date of general public availability is not established by these sources.

claims.qualification: Invitation-based access is the stage the release states; it is not general public availability. The release's capability descriptions and enterprise application figures are Baidu's own statements and are not recorded as facts. The Chinese product name 文心一言 does not appear in the cited English release.

evidence.passage: Starting March 16, 2023, ERNIE Bot will be accessible to invited users, and the API will be available upon application to enterprise clients via Baidu AI Cloud.
ERNIE Bot is a new-generation large language model (LLM) and generative AI product developed by Baidu.
Baidu released ERNIE Bot, our conversational AI bot powered by ERNIE, our in-house foundation model in the first quarter of 2023.

claims.statement: The PaddlePaddle/ERNIE repository README at its commit of 30 June 2025 introduces ERNIE 4.5 as a family of ten model variants and states that the models, including pre-trained weights and inference code, have been released on Hugging Face and AI Studio.

time.note: Commit date of the cited README revision. Baidu's 20-F filed on 17 March 2026 states that Baidu open-sourced the ERNIE 4.5 series in June 2025; the Hugging Face repositories were created on 28 and 29 June 2025, but the date they became public is not established.

'Open-sourced' is Baidu's term; the record makes no judgement of openness beyond the stated licence.

Baidu open-sourced the ERNIE 4.5 series, its latest and most advanced family of foundation models comprising ten models of different architectures and sizes, in June 2025.
